methodology: Primary region is inferred from the RuneScape Wiki quest start-area field, then adjusted only where League region boundaries have stronger evidence. Required regions are the union of that primary region and recursively required quest regions from Module:Questreq/data. Catalyst is used as historical League precedent for ambiguous localities: it grouped both City of Um and Fort Forinthry under Misthalin, while Equilibrium's official reveal explicitly places Daemonheim in Forinthry (Wilderness). These are planner mappings, not an Equilibrium quest auto-completion list. Official auto-completions remain a separate Jagex-only overlay.
